text:
We're turning our lessons from defending OpenAI into practical tools for our customers. On Thursday, join us at Cyber at the Frontier, a live keynote, for our latest cyber announcements.

Working with our frontier models, we've identified and resolved important vulnerabilities in our own code and infrastructure. That experience is informing the tools and playbooks we're building to help other security teams strengthen their defenses.

@gdb shares what we've learned and why security teams should keep putting the latest models to work as capabilities improve.

Tune in on November 12 at 10 a.m. PT:
name: OpenAI

text:
We built Control Room, a central system to track model workloads across our research infrastructure and stop them quickly when safety or security concerns arise.

It connects every research inference workload, including agentic sampling for model training and evaluation, data processing, and more. This works together with our misalignment monitoring systems, and halts model output within 35 seconds of a decision to intervene to stop or pause a job.

Control Room is just one part of our holistic approach for safe frontier model training and deployment.
name: OpenAI
